arms.baseline: teacher, replacement off (reused from the completed benchmark)
arms.static: teacher weights + calibrated per-step means, no training (stage 0)
arms.dense_control: stage-2/3 recipe without replacement (center mode off)
arms.deletion: stage-2/3 recipe with HIGH coordinates zeroed (center mode delete)

config.note: Same 100 prompts and seeds as center_benchmark_wan.json so every arm pairs with the existing baseline/all/high videos.

bootstrap.unit: paired prompt with its one fixed seed; retain all arms together
bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of resampled mean paired difference
